entries.note: Page opened. Prices per m3 for unsawn logs/pieces accepted in tenders, not sawn slabs and not an asking price for this item. A 2 m x 0.3 m x 0.05 m slab is about 0.03 m3, so raw timber value is only about $35 to $130 before milling and drying; retail sawn Huon is dearer but no retail slab price was verified.

searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) with huon pine slab, huon pine, live edge slab, huon pine timber: only Gowans local results (about 670 hits, median about $75) and one tender log price. WebSearch budget was exhausted so no web search ran. Direct fetch of islandspecialtytimbers.com.au price archive and boards page (opened). No retail Huon slab price, no other auction house SOLD and no UNSOLD found. eBay sold listings and Tasmanian dealer prices (Hobart timber merchants, Huon Pine retail per board foot) would settle resale better.
chrome_hint: eBay Australia sold listings: 'huon pine slab' and 'huon pine live edge slab'; also Google 'huon pine slab for sale' for retail dealer prices (Tasmanian timber merchants).
viewing_check: Smell a cut or scratched face (Huon pine has a strong distinctive oil scent), check end grain for very tight rings, measure length, width and thickness, and check for splits, rot and bark softness. Compare with celery-top pine and similar pale slabs: Gowans often catalogues pale slabs as Huon.
